messages:
maria nguyen: FYI onboarding sampleapp started throwing a bunch of 429s right after the STS token rotation yesterday

samir patel: which flow? prefetch or normal pagination?

maria nguyen: prefetch + initial paginate. we prewarm 8 cursors on signup. some inflight requests got 401, SDK retried immediately, and those retries were counted as new inflight by the client window -> blew past the limiter

leo.bot: alert: sampleapp-onboard-prewarm spike: 7.8k 429s in 30s (us-west-2) :rotating_light:

samir patel: can you paste a sanitized log snippet? want to check retry/backoff behaviour

maria nguyen: logs:
```
[2026-03-22T09:03:12Z] prefetcher:start id=cur-1 token=tmpA
[2026-03-22T09:03:12Z] http GET /v1/generate status=401 token=tmpA
[2026-03-22T09:03:12Z] sdk-retry: retry=1 reason=auth_swap token=tmpB
[2026-03-22T09:03:12Z] limiter: inflight=18 limit=16 action=throttle status=429
```

cassandra li: sounds like token-swap retry is immediately enqueued and increments inflight. we don't special-case auth retries. other SDKs might hold the slot until success

samir patel: i reproduced with a tiny script: spawn 6 prefetch workers, fail first call with 401, immediate retry -> local inflight counts overshoot. quick repro in JS I used locally

maria nguyen: temporary mitigation: reduce prefetch window from 8 to 3 and enable exponential retry backoff in sampleapp until SDK patch lands

cassandra li: long-term options: 1) change SDK to not count auth-retries against concurrency until a non-401 response, or 2) add short-window dedupe/fingerprint so retries within ~2s are collapsed

samir patel: i'll open a small PR to hold a slot until the first non-401 or timeout (opt-in), and also add a sampleapp flag `prefetch_retry_hold` so teams can opt in right away

deploy-bot: canary deploy: sampleapp-staging prefetch_retry_hold=true by @samir patel

maria nguyen: thanks, i'll update onboarding docs: note about 429s right after auth rotation + mitigation steps

leo.bot: reaction :thumbsup: from 4 users

samir patel: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/469 small patch + unit tests. follow-up: add language parity checks across go/python/js

cassandra li: filing internal ticket to audit auth-retry behaviour across SDKs and add sampleapp guidance

maria nguyen: monitoring looks quieter after canary, will keep an eye and escalate if it resurges
